title: Rabbi Yohanan ben Matya
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mishnah Bava Metzia 7:1 relates that Rabbi Yohanan ben Matya sent his son to hire workers. The son promised them food. On his return, his father said: “My son, even a feast like Solomon’s in his day would not discharge your obligation to them, for they are descendants of Abraham, Isaac and Jacob. Before they begin work, tell them that you owe them only bread and legumes.” The passage implies that he preceded Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel.

notes.text: The full Mishnah spells Abraham, Isaac and Jacob and Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel. These expansions follow the actual cited passage.
The Mishnah was directly inspected; the inference that Yohanan ben Matya preceded Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel remains Hyman’s.
